describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal with the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a brown bear, shown in right-facing profile standing on a pale ground with small tufts of grass under its feet. Its body is covered in long shaggy fur that is dark brown on the back, legs and top of the head and lighter cream-tan on the muzzle, lower chest and belly. A single large glossy black curved horn projects from the center of its forehead, and multiple glossy dark reddish-brown chitinous plates with segmented lines and highlights are set into the fur on its back, sides, shoulders, hips and outer legs, with a row of six small oval black openings edged in light fur on the lower side beneath the largest side plate.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal with thick shaggy brown fur like a bear stands in side view facing right. Its body, head, ears, legs and clawed paws are bear-like, but glossy dark reddish-brown segmented plates like a beetle's shell cover its neck, shoulders, back, sides, hips and upper legs, and a single long curved glossy dark horn with small barbs rises from its forehead. A row of six small black oval spots sits on the pale fur of its flank beneath a large side plate.
